items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: No. Dudley Moore was not on that. He was in the crowd but he wasn’t one of those guys.

ctx.x: No. Dudley Moore was not on that. He was in the crowd but he wasn’t one of those guys. This was Spike Milligan and what else. Well at any rate, they used to broadcast those things from London. And I thought they were the funniest things I ever heard in my life. And they would listen to that and they looked at me like I’m nuts. Crazy. So I played them these records, “That’s awful.” Well anyway that’s what it was about. That was the Salty Dogs. We have one record we left testament.
You seem to be really attracted to — oh gosh I don’t know if “authentic” is the right word, but a certain kind of historical thing. Like I know you are very fond of Jelly Roll.
